title: Dividend Administration Decision Table: Termination Dividend at a Whole Life Insurance Reduced Paid-Up Election When a Loan Is Extinguished
content:
At a reduced paid-up election on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the termination dividend is cut where the election extinguishes a loan. The test compares the principal on the loan offset entry for the election with the guaranteed cash value plus the paid-up additions cash value.

## Decision table

| Principal on the loan offset entry for the election | Termination dividend paid |
|---|---|
| At least 25% (0.25) of the guaranteed cash value plus the paid-up additions cash value | 50% (0.5) of its amount |
| Above zero but below 25% of those values | 80% (0.8) of its amount |
| No loan extinguished | In full |

The reduced amount is rounded half up to the cent; the share is taken of the unrounded termination dividend.

## Inputs

- The loan offset entry booked on the nonforfeiture occasion for the election: its principal.
- The guaranteed cash value and the paid-up additions cash value on the policy record, as of the most recent anniversary.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, guaranteed cash value 30000.00, additions cash value 4000.00, so 25% of the values is 8500.00; termination dividend before the cut 900.00)

| Offset principal | Share | Termination dividend paid |
|---|---|---|
| 8500.00 | 0.5 | 450.00 |
| 8499.99 | 0.8 | 720.00 |
| No offset entry | Full | 900.00 |
